name: IVX 112 Live AI Worker Certificate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  live-112-worker-cert:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      API_BASE: https://api.ivxholding.com
      EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT: '112'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Wait for production exact SHA
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          matched=0
          for i in $(seq 1 120); do
            code=$(curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/version.json -w '%{http_code}' "${API_BASE}/version" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
              ok=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/version.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)
              commit=$(jq -r '.commit // empty' /tmp/version.json 2>/dev/null || true)
              echo "poll=$i ok=$ok production_sha=${commit:-missing} expected=${GITHUB_SHA}"
              if [ "$ok" = "true" ] && [ "$commit" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
                matched=1
                break
              fi
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$matched" != "1" ]; then
            echo "Production did not reach exact SHA ${GITHUB_SHA}."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "exact_sha=PASS"

      - name: Load and validate every registered agent
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "${API_BASE}/api/ivx/agents" -o /tmp/agents.json
          ok=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/agents.json)
          total=$(jq -r '.totalAgents // 0' /tmp/agents.json)
          unique_ids=$(jq '[.agents[].agentId] | unique | length' /tmp/agents.json)
          unique_numbers=$(jq '[.agents[].agentNumber] | unique | length' /tmp/agents.json)
          min_number=$(jq '[.agents[].agentNumber] | min // 0' /tmp/agents.json)
          max_number=$(jq '[.agents[].agentNumber] | max // 0' /tmp/agents.json)
          missing_identity=$(jq '[.agents[] | select((.agentId // "") == "" or (.name // "") == "" or (.role // "") == "" or (.division // "") == "")] | length' /tmp/agents.json)
          echo "ok=$ok total=$total unique_ids=$unique_ids unique_numbers=$unique_numbers min=$min_number max=$max_number missing_identity=$missing_identity"
          test "$ok" = "true"
          test "$total" = "$EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT"
          test "$unique_ids" = "$EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT"
          test "$unique_numbers" = "$EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT"
          test "$min_number" = "1"
          test "$max_number" = "$EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT"
          test "$missing_identity" = "0"
          echo "registered_agent_registry=PASS count=$total"

      - name: Execute every registered agent through real live AI inference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p qa/evidence
          : > /tmp/worker-results.jsonl
          failures=0
          total=$(jq -r '.totalAgents' /tmp/agents.json)

          for idx in $(seq 0 $((total - 1))); do
            agentId=$(jq -r ".agents[$idx].agentId" /tmp/agents.json)
            agentNumber=$(jq -r ".agents[$idx].agentNumber" /tmp/agents.json)
            agentName=$(jq -r ".agents[$idx].name" /tmp/agents.json)
            role=$(jq -r ".agents[$idx].role" /tmp/agents.json)
            division=$(jq -r ".agents[$idx].division" /tmp/agents.json)
            token="IVX-LIVE-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${agentNumber}"
            requestId="ivx-live-worker-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${agentNumber}"

              --arg agentName "$agentName" \
              --arg role "$role" \
              --arg division "$division" \
              --arg requestId "$requestId" \
              --arg source "$source" \
              --arg endpoint "$endpoint" \

              --argjson http "$http" \
              --argjson passed "$passed" \

              >> /tmp/worker-results.jsonl

            echo "worker=$agentNumber division=$division source=${source:-missing} http=$http token=$containsToken pass=$passed"
            sleep 1
          done

          jq -s '.' /tmp/worker-results.jsonl > /tmp/worker-results.json
          executed=$(jq 'length' /tmp/worker-results.json)
          passed=$(jq '[.[] | select(.passed == true)] | length' /tmp/worker-results.json)
          uniqueAgents=$(jq '[.[].agentId] | unique | length' /tmp/worker-results.json)
          uniqueRequests=$(jq '[.[].requestId] | unique | length' /tmp/worker-results.json)

          endpointPass=$(jq '[.[] | select((.endpoint // "") != "")] | length' /tmp/worker-results.json)

          jq -n \
            --arg githubSha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --arg workflowRunId "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --arg certifiedAt "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            --argjson expectedAgents "$EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT" \
            --argjson totalWorkers "$executed" \
            --argjson passedWorkers "$passed" \
            --argjson failedWorkers "$failures" \
            --argjson uniqueAgents "$uniqueAgents" \
            --argjson uniqueRequests "$uniqueRequests" \
            --argjson realProviderResponses "$sourcePass" \
            --argjson providerEndpointsReported "$endpointPass" \
            --slurpfile workers /tmp/worker-results.json \
            '{marker:"ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert-2026-08-16-v2",githubSha:$githubSha,workflowRunId:$workflowRunId,certifiedAt:$certifiedAt,exactSha:true,expectedAgents:$expectedAgents,totalWorkers:$totalWorkers,passedWorkers:$passedWorkers,failedWorkers:$failedWorkers,uniqueAgents:$uniqueAgents,uniqueRequests:$uniqueRequests,realProviderResponses:$realProviderResponses,providerEndpointsReported:$providerEndpointsReported,certified:($totalWorkers==$expectedAgents and $passedWorkers==$expectedAgents and $failedWorkers==0 and $uniqueAgents==$expectedAgents and $uniqueRequests==$expectedAgents and $realProviderResponses==$expectedAgents and $providerEndpointsReported==$expectedAgents),proofDefinition:"Every agent in the current 112-agent IVX enterprise registry completed an independent real remote AI inference against the exact production SHA; this does not claim separate operating-system processes or separate model-provider accounts.",workers:$workers[0]}' \
            > qa/evidence/ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert.json

          jq '{certified,githubSha,expectedAgents,totalWorkers,passedWorkers,failedWorkers,uniqueAgents,uniqueRequests,realProviderResponses,providerEndpointsReported,proofDefinition}' qa/evidence/ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert.json

          certified=$(jq -r '.certified' qa/evidence/ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert.json)
          if [ "$certified" != "true" ]; then
            echo "112 live AI worker certificate failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "live_112_ai_workers=PASS"

      - name: Upload 112-worker live certificate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert-${{ github.sha }}
          path: qa/evidence/ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert.json
          if-no-files-found: error

Each agent operates through this cycle:

4. **Token Verification** — Each response must contain the exact unique token, proving the agent processed its specific prompt
5. **Evidence Artifact** — Results saved to `qa/evidence/ivx-112-live-ai-worker-cert.json` with per-agent pass/fail, source, endpoint, and answer hash
